§6Personal Protection§f

§aYou cannot walk through pollution unprotected. Craft a respirator before your lungs give out.§f

As your base expands, chunks fill with carbon, sulfur, and dust. Stepping into these zones without breathing gear means instant debuffs. A §9Respirator§f in your head slot keeps you alive.

§6Respirator Tiers§f:
§b- Iron Respirator§f: §e600 seconds§f of filtration. The bare minimum.
§b- Gold Respirator§f: §e720 seconds§f. A bit more breathing room.
§b- Diamond Respirator§f: §e1440 seconds§f. Twice the gold tier.

§6Filter Materials§f: Respirators filter §eCarbon§f and §eSulfur§f. You insert filter materials into the respirator, and they deplete as you breathe. Each material handles §e8 blocks§f of capacity:
§b- Tree Leaves§f: yields §bCoal Dust§f as you use them
§b- Wool§f (any color): yields §bSulfur Dust§f
§b- Paper§f: yields §bClay Balls§f

§cWARNING:§f Keep spare filters in your inventory. When the respirator runs dry, you are exposed to everything in the air. Check the durability bar and swap materials before it hits zero.
